profile.background: CS / EE background; Python + basic ROS; simulation demos; limited real hardware access. Need evidence that is stronger than tutorial reproduction.

trends.name: Robot Data / Eval Tooling
trends.note: Embodied systems need repeatable evaluation, data quality and failure analysis.

trends.name: Simulation-to-real Reliability
trends.note: Reliability and acceptance testing remain hard engineering problems.

trends.name: ROS Observability / Recovery
trends.note: Less flashy but directly connected to production debugging and operations.

trends.name: Generic Humanoid Demo
trends.note: High attention, but individual proof is difficult without hardware and system ownership.

wedge.name: Robotics Evaluation + Failure Recovery
wedge.thesis: Evaluation, recovery and reproducibility are accessible without a robot fleet, map to real engineering pain, and create stronger proof than another simulation success video.
wedge.killCriteria: Target roles reject simulation evidence entirely or consistently require hardware/control depth that the current wedge cannot demonstrate.
wedge.nextTest: Build a fixed-scenario simulator benchmark that records success, collisions, retries, failure types and recovery regressions.

proofs.name: Robot Task Evaluation Benchmark
proofs.evidence: Scenario configs + benchmark runner + result JSON + failure taxonomy

claims.claim: Built a reproducible simulated robotics benchmark with fixed scenarios and recovery evaluation
claims.ownership: Benchmark design, failure taxonomy, recovery logic
claims.risk: How were random seeds and scenario difficulty controlled?
Define reliability precisely and separate simulation evidence from real-world claims

position.safe: Robotics software candidate focused on evaluation, reliability and reproducible simulation workflows.
position.stretch: Physical AI / robotics software candidate with hands-on task benchmarks, failure taxonomies and recovery logic.
position.gaps: Hardware integration; sensor/actuator constraints; real-time systems; field failures; sim-to-real validation.

applications.next: Map whether role pain is eval, integration, controls or model training
Share benchmark/failure-analysis artifact with clear simulation boundary

interview.risk: Overstating simulation work as real-world robotics experience
interview.weakness: Need explicit understanding of what assumptions break on physical hardware.
interview.drill: Which simulator assumptions are unrealistic, what would you log on hardware, and how would you design a sim-to-real acceptance test?
